source_evidence.reuse_evidence: experiment-reports/servers/server1/price-storage-inventory-20261007/report-ko.md / audit inventory lists existing GPT2-XL model.safetensors/pytorch_model.bin; availability is historical metadata not model verification.
source_evidence.bindings: SH1 fresh read/pin native closure (runningstats/tok_dataset/nethook), tokenizer/model exact revision/config/weight files, dataset revision/content/index subset/order/token rule/runtime and stats/P output identity. local native edits are explicit source provenance, not unverified upstream equivalence.

model.revision: SH1 resolve existing checkout commit and actual payload hashes, seal exact revision before execution; do not silently choose latest
model.orientation: GPT2 Conv1D weight[input,output]; derive actual input width (expected6400) from live module/config, never Llama down_proj transpose assumptions. model eval/frozen/no weight editing. Cache name must preserve gpt2-xl logical identity regardless snapshot-directory basename.
model.precision: FP32 model and native FP32 moment arithmetic, TF32/autocast off; record actual backend/runtime and any difference from historical cache. no reduced-precision shortcut.

statistics.sampler: native tally FixedRandomSubsetSampler random_sample=1; preserve exact selected document IDs/order for all layers/lanes. Existing compatible sealed subset may reuse.
statistics.tokenization: native GPT2 tokenizer, maxlen actual n_positions=1024, native attention mask flattening and length_collation. default batch_tokens=n_positions*3; token truncation/sample count cannot be reduced for speed.
statistics.measure: SecondMoment on INPUT to each c_proj; store original sum/count .npz schema, moment=sum/count = uncentered second moment. count is actual masked token vectors, not blindly100000. No centered covariance/un-normalized raw sum as C0.
statistics.outputs: 5 native-compatible float32_mom2_100000.npz assets, each layer SHA/size/count/data/token/model/source binding. Alternative shared multilayer forward only if same W0/rows/input mask/FP32 reduction semantics are maintained and declared.
statistics.existing_assets: matching C0/P verified identity may reuse; missing layers only recompute. Missing incompatible assets separate namespace, no overwrite. Avoid two writers/races on one native cache path.
statistics.source_caution: Current layer_stats main CLI may omit hparams although runtime uses hparams.device. Use sealed task wrapper passing proper hparams/device; don't execute AlphaEdit apply_... (would perform edits) or mutate shared EasyEdit code.

projector.dependency: each projector depends on its corresponding completed/verified C0. It is not an independent measurement and must not race incomplete stats.
projector.expected_shape: 5 x d_in x d_in, d_in derived actual GPT2 c_proj
projector.rules: native CPU SVD default, deterministic exact input provenance; do not replace with pinv, arbitrary eigenspace threshold, layer subset, new normalization or .01 threshold. Individual layer partials may be new task assets; atomic final stacked .pt only after all5 verified.
projector.validation: finite/shape/dtype, native threshold rank/spectrum boundary, symmetry/idempotence and retained-subspace C0 residual with declared numerical tolerance; original C0 PSD/symmetry/count. Residual near nonzero eigenvalues below.02 is expected, do not require C0P==0. No quality/edit-performance gate.
projector.name: null_space_project_gpt2-xl.pt

parallelism.count_scope: all current server1 owner allocations plus preparation. Respect any stricter current cap. No other jobs cancel/preempt.
parallelism.implementation: Use up to2 disjoint layer stats lanes (e.g.13/14/15 and16/17) with exact same dataset subset/token policy; or per-layer array%2. Per-layer P CPU processing can overlap remaining GPU stats after exact atomic READY/source/C0 SHA. All P jobs cannot start on missing stats.
parallelism.dependency: Slurm afterok for required stats→projector/pack correctness; failure collector afterany for audit. CPU P jobs no GPU request, bounded aggregate CPU/RAM; already-ready cache can project immediately.
parallelism.no_duplicate_forward: Don't launch redundant stats collection just to use both slots. Existing exact stats bypass re-computation. No duplicate model preload or whole-Wikipedia duplicate downloads per lane.

GPU_job.partition_QoS: fresh resolve canonical node and current policy

resources.admission: SH1 actual own queue, Slurm partition/node/QoS, memory per GPU/CPU-only rules, disk/inodes/cache/outputs/reserve. Fit within actual policies using explicit memory. wall caps are requests not ETA. Pending is normal; held owner/fullargv/source/resource/dependency inspection then release.
resources.monitoring: bounded startup/READY or formal resource-pending handoff only. No recurring monitor/heartbeat/autoretry/new long agent polling. Sealed workers/projector/collector finish naturally; return actual submit IDs/dependencies and initial status, not completion claim.

assets.keep: existing model/bin/safetensors/dataset/C0/P/old outputs read-only. User explicitly authorizes new statistics/projector tensors for reusable preparation; no-model-checkpoint policy is not a ban on these requested assets.
assets.downloads: Reuse existing local pinned model and Wikipedia cache first. If necessary public canonical tokenizer/config/model or exact native Wikipedia snapshot/subset download is allowed only after SHA/revision/storage-bound plan; no arbitrary model/dataset substitutions, no secrets/private data upload. Missing protected/network prerequisite must be stated, not bypassed.
assets.publish_alias: Do not overwrite EasyEdit native cache/projector. New manifest supplies absolute paths + stats/P logical mapping for later GPT2 adapters. Existing original assets untouched.
assets.server2: Publish small readiness/profile/manifest for future server2 use. No server2 jobs or bulk tensor transfer this turn; source remains server1 authoritative.
assets.no_checkpoints: No edited/full-model/optimizer/H checkpoints. Only explicitly requested C0/P assets + small manifest/diagnostic/log.

ours_compatibility.profile: Persist model family/revision/tokenizer, layers13..17/anchor17/readout47, Conv1D shape/transposition/keyinput dims/context/lookup mapping, C0 normalization/Pphysical indices/native threshold. These are asset readiness, not ours method GPU parity or baseline performance certification.
ours_compatibility.non_goal: Do not import GPT2 baseline lr.5 or mom2 weight20000 into PRICE/ours planner, don't change PRICE global coefficients. No ours new arm fitting/2k or baseline edit now.

tracking.execution: Each compute lane/preparation attempt gets explicit task/layer phase/run identity, approved scalar progress/count/time/memory/status only; no token texts/model/C0/P/raw tensors/code upload. CPU-only operations similarly capture phase metrics via approved helper without GPU duplication.
tracking.helper: project/run_scripts/experiment_tracking/** SH1 existing helper; caller adapter preferred, preserve scientific env. User reported login; safe no-prompt auth/project check rather than assuming. If missing AUTH report explicitly; don't publish secret or claim online.

reporting.required: actual model/data/runtime/input source lock; stats sample/count/layer mapping, P rank/error/sha size; job IDs/dependency/compute/storage/time, noCP exception scope/W&B run URLs; missing/partial explicit
reporting.Git: dedicated non-main branch, exact scope only, clean nonforce main publication authorized, dirty root/source/otherworktree preserved. Tensor assets stay local.
reporting.broadcast: NO_BROADCAST_NOT_REQUIRED now (small manifest on Git); no bulk peer broadcast automatically.
